close_reason: stoa-5yi4k.4: MtaStsEnforcer now owns a TokioResolver built once in new(); lookup_mta_sts_txt takes &TokioResolver parameter. stoa-5yi4k.6: fetch_url now uses response.chunk() loop with inline size check — body capped during streaming, not after full buffering. All 291 tests pass.
description: mta_sts_fetcher.rs:78 calls response.bytes().await which reads the entire body into memory, then checks len > max_body_bytes on line 83. A server without Content-Length that streams >64 KiB will fill memory before the check fires. Fix: use bytes_stream() with a running counter and abort when the limit is exceeded. The comment 'Read body with byte cap' is misleading — the cap is applied after buffering, not during.
title: fetch_url reads full response body before enforcing size limit — unbounded buffer
